reason: The README clearly describes an approval-gate plugin for DeepSeek Harness that evaluates sandbox-boundary actions, automates selected approvals, routes hard-risk actions to humans, and provides review timelines and file-diff tools; its primary purpose is workflow automation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于风险判定的沙箱越界审批、人工复核、审批时间线和文件差异查看功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with risk-based sandbox-boundary approvals, human review, approval timelines, and file-diff inspection.

capabilities: Evaluates sandbox-boundary operations with a Flash model
Automatically approves selected operations based on allowlists and confirmed-operation learning
Routes designated high-risk operations to human review
Displays approval timelines and file diffs
Provides session snapshot management and file-revert instructions
